acceptanceCriteria: lane pushes that edit .github/workflows succeed via the documented path, or the charter documents the SSH fallback
body: Tooling friction from the V1-1351 lane (PR #943, 2026-10-15). git push over HTTPS with the gh credential helper is refused for commits that modify .github/workflows/*.yml because the gh OAuth token lacks the workflow scope. Workaround used: push the same commits over SSH (git@github.com:beamfall/corvint.git). Expected: lane pushes of workflow edits succeed through the documented path. Actual: refusal; agents must know the SSH fallback. Fix options: owner refreshes gh auth with the workflow scope (gh auth refresh -s workflow), or the lane charter documents the SSH push for .github changes.
title: gh OAuth token lacks workflow scope: HTTPS pushes touching .github/workflows are refused
